icons.name: outfit
icons.prompt: Create ONE production Android app UI icon for a private couple's lifestyle journal. Subject: a single elegantly simplified clothes hanger, clearly recognizable at 24dp. Art direction: premium restrained iOS-inspired micro-3D frosted ceramic, pearl ivory and muted dusty rose, cool graphite accents for a crisp readable silhouette, soft studio light from upper left, nearly front view with very subtle depth, no strong cast shadow. Not cute cartoon, not glossy plastic, not ornate. Centered object fills 80% of square with balanced padding. Truly transparent background, no tile, no base, no text, no watermark. This is the reference icon for a cohesive collection including meals, heart, sunrise, sun, moon, settings, profile, cloud sync, backup, battery and appearance. Only the hanger in this output. Generate with Image2 as requested.
